_doc: Building lots and vacant buildings on the town map (world/lotBook.js, world/townPlanner.js, world/innerMap/lots.js, systems/lots.js). The planner sets lots aside along the streets before the houses fill in: count[type] of them (many in a village, few in a city: a city is built up), each width x depth tiles. Anyone may buy one — the player or an AI House or townsman — and build inside its bounds; the player builds only on a lot they hold (or out in the wilds). pricePerTile[type] × the lot's area is its price. vacant[type]: houses left standing empty in town, for rent (rentPerDay[type] gold a day, paid at each day's end; miss a day and you're put out) or for sale (salePrice[type]). ai: the chance each day, per town, that someone buys a free lot (buyChance), takes a vacant house (rentChance) or leaves one (leaveChance); buildDays from purchase to the building standing; builds: what they put up (building types with designs); buyers: townsfolk names when no House buys.
